items.quote: Clients Are Ghosting You after a Great Call or Presentation? You feel all went so well - and they just stop respondig on your calls and messages?
items.statement: Clients can stop responding after a seemingly good call or presentation.

items.quote: One way to blame the LEADS - you know the Favorite -Leads are bad!
items.statement: It is common to blame bad leads when clients ghost after a good meeting.

items.quote: However just being angry and upset with clients will not make you more money - what to do instead...
items.statement: Being angry and upset with clients is not a productive way to respond to being ghosted.

items.quote: Will you recognise your own Mistakes here?
items.statement: The author suggests that self-reflection on mistakes can help agents improve their client interactions.

items.quote: ...I explained in my Live Client - Agent role play Call review.
items.statement: The author offers a Live Client-Agent role play Call review as a learning opportunity.

overview: A LinkedIn post discussing client engagement and strategies to improve communication after initial interactions.
